messages:
alex: quick postmortem follow-up: we keep seeing a tight loop where resolver failures trigger immediate cross-region fallback + host blacklist, which cascades into TLS fallback mismatches and client retries. need owners + short timelines.
priya: yep saw that. timeline was 04:07 UTC, many clients hit a remote region after the primary was marked degraded for a ~2s window. retry amplification obvious in traces.
sam: logs look like this:
```
2026-03-05T04:07:12Z lb.edge: resolver_timeout host=svc-internal, attempts=1
2026-03-05T04:07:12Z lb.edge: mark_host_degraded host=10.12.8.9 reason=resolve_fail window=2s
2026-03-05T04:07:12Z lb.edge: route_fallback target_region=eu-west-1 reason=degraded_primary
2026-03-05T04:07:12Z tls.cache: sni_mismatch host=10.12.8.9 fallback_cert=none
```
ken: hypothesis: our degrade heuristics are too sensitive to transient DNS errors + IP-level blacklisting doesn't play well with cert rotation timing.
olivia: agree. small set of actions I think we can do quickly.
priya: propose action list (owners + targets):
- B1: Add a short resolver wrapper that does 2 fast retries with 200ms jitter and only returns SERVFAIL after exponential backoff (owner: ken). ETA: 48h to PR, canary in 5 days.
- B2: Change degrade policy: require 2 distinct resolution failures OR persistent handshake failures across 5s before blacklisting IP; prefer marking host as 'probation' instead of full blacklist (owner: sam). ETA: design doc in 2 days, rollout 1 week.
- B3: Add cross-region failover throttle: if >30% requests are failing on fallback region in 60s, pause cross-region routing and surface alert (owner: olivia). ETA: metric+alert in 3 days.
- B4: Synthetic probe: add a small periodic probe per upstream to validate TLS cert+SNI post-rotate; if probe fails, delay routing to that host (owner: rachel). ETA: prototype this week.
- B5: Recurrence detector: add a retrospective alert that triggers when we see the same pattern (resolver timeout -> immediate blacklist -> cross-region spike) three times in 14 days (owner: alex). ETA: 1 week.
ken: I'll take B1. impl note: keep it in-process in lb-agent, don't touch system glibc resolver. tests will simulate SERVFAIL + SERVING responses.
sam: B2 requires small state-machine; I'll draft the state transitions and failure counters. will share for review tomorrow.
olivia: B3 I'll add a grafana panel + pager rule; want to avoid noisy pages so we'll gate on sustained failures.
rachel: B4: will spin up a canary probe in staging that does a full TLS handshake + SNI check and record latency. will post script in INC-4635.
infra-bot: Created INC-4635: https://tracker.internal/INC-4635 - "edge: resolver flapping -> cross-region fallback mitigation" assigned to triage
alex: please put PR links + deploys in INC-4635. i'll run a brief sync next Tue to confirm status. if any blocker, tag eng-oncall. :white_check_mark:
priya: quick note: update runbook with "probation" semantics and rollback steps for B1/B2. owner: priya. ETA: 3 days.
ken: starting B1 branch now. will ping #eng-runtime when ready.
rachel: adding e2e case to simulate DNS success after cert rotate; ensure we don't flip route for <10s.
sam: once B2 is in, we should re-run the postmortem scenario in the chaos harness. owner: sam+ken.
alex: thanks all. small ask: include any customer-facing impact notes if deploys overlap with maintenance windows. otherwise we proceed.
